- কবিতাটি হচ্ছে একটি didactic poem in heroic couplets.
- ১৭১১ সালে কবির ২২ বছর বয়সে এই কবিতাটি anonymously প্রকাশিত হয়।

- In it Pope set out poetic rules, a Neoclassical compendium of maxims, with a combination of ambitious argument and great stylistic assurance. The poem received much attention and brought Pope a wider circle of friends, notably Joseph Addison and Richard Steele, who were then collaborating on The Spectator.

• John Milton is the author of 'Samson Agonistes'.
- ১৬৭১ সালে কবিতাটি প্রকাশিত হয়।
- It was published in the same volume as his epic Paradise Regained.
- এটি মুলত একটি tragedy.
- It is considered the greatest English drama based on the Greek model and is known as a closet tragedy.
- The work deals with the final phase of Samson’s life and recounts the story as told in the biblical Book of Judges.

• John Milton is best known for Paradise Lost, widely regarded as the greatest epic poem in English.
- Together with Paradise Regained and Samson Agonistes, it confirms Milton’s reputation as one of the greatest English poets.
